text: I am kindly asking for your support of my motion to traffic calming along Everden Road, between Eglinton Avenue West and Gloucester Grove. Residents of Everden Road submitted a petition to my office requesting the installation of speed humps to help reduce speeding, discourage cut-through traffic and improve the safety of their street. There is a long history of commuters dangerously speeding along Everden Road as a means of bypassing traffic to reach the Allen Road on ramp. With the passage of this motion, the community will receive the traffic calming measures they have been organizing for.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (three speed humps) on Everden Road, between Eglinton Avenue West and Gloucester Grove, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 7, 2026) from Councillor Josh Matlow.
